verdict.rationale: Docs confirm core ANN similarity search — Chroma auto-embeds and returns the 'n most similar results' for a query, and supports pluggable embedding models — establishing the basic ANN capability. However, the evidence pack never documents configurable distance metrics (e.g., cosine/L2/IP) or how to select them, so that specific part of the story is unsupported. missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable distance-metric options, independent benchmarking of ANN recall/latency.
